# UptimeBar

Status-page style bars — one per day or check — green up, orange degraded, red down, grey no data; hover/focus shows the day, the header the uptime %.

`KenosUI.UptimeBar` · Homelab

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.UptimeBar status="up" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.UptimeBar" status="up"></x-import>
```
